verdict.rationale: Quo documents a first-party public MCP server and one-click Claude/ChatGPT connectors that let users manage conversations, contacts, call history, voicemail transcripts and outbound texts "in plain English" with no coding required. That covers the product's core day-to-day operations through natural-language commands. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language control over admin and configuration tasks (call routing, phone menus, number setup), a native in-app natural-language command surface rather than one reached through an external agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect Quo to any agent and manage your conversations, contacts, and call transcripts in plain English. No coding required.
One-click connectors for Claude and ChatGPT, plus a public MCP server and an API your own agent can read and act on.
Search your contact list, look up a specific contact’s details, add new contacts, or update existing ones just by asking.
Send a text to one person or broadcast the same message to multiple team members from your Quo number, without opening your workspace.
